name: Out of Touch!
source:
After being sent away by his mother due to a terrible misunderstanding involving his closest friend, our protagonist CJ returns years later for the last two semesters of high school completely changed in both body and spirit.

Wielding a newfound power and determined to rekindle his old relationships, can CJ convince his friends he's the same person they used to know? Can he avoid ruining absolutely everything like the doofus he is?

Out of Touch is a psychedelic melodramatic comedy about a group of childhood friends as they grow up, grow apart, and reconnect...before everything really goes off the deep end! Taking an inspiration from psychedelic thrillers, Out of Touch is an extremely odd journey through several genres from teenage romance to existential horror.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/story_anon]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
由于涉及他最亲密的朋友的可怕误会而被母亲送走后，我们的主角CJ多年后回来，在高中的最后两个学期，身体和精神都发生了彻底的变化。

运用新发现的力量并决心重燃旧有关系，CJ能否让朋友们相信他还是他们以前认识的那个人？他能避免像他这个傻瓜一样毁掉一切吗？

《Out of Touch》是一部迷幻情节喜剧，讲述了一群儿时好友的成长、疏远、重新联系……在一切真正陷入困境之前！《Out of Touch》的灵感来自迷幻惊悚片，是一次极其奇怪的旅程，涵盖了从青少年浪漫到存在恐怖等多种类型。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/story_anon]Patreon[/url]]
